theorem: (A OR x) AND (A OR NOT x) == A

implementation_evidence.v12_canonical_formula: preserves clause and literal order rather than normalizing clause semantics

root_cause: The v18 provider treats clause bodies as ordered tuples. Clause semantics are invariant under literal permutation, so semantically identical complementary-twin bodies can be missed when their literal order differs in the current internal residual.
secondary_gap: The existing-body check `positive_body in kept` is also order-sensitive and should use the same semantic body key.
hephaestus_lesson: Hephaestus normalization correctly exposed that the residual still contains a logical twin, but its display order must not be used as runtime scan order. It remains a recurrence/fingerprint/accounting layer only.
repair_requirement: Use a deterministic order-invariant semantic clause-body key.
Use the same semantic key for twin equality and already-present detection.
Do not modify the v18 theorem.
Do not retroactively rewrite v18/v18.1 receipts.
Freeze a fresh holdout before running the repair provider.
Charge comparison, normalization, failed discovery, certificate, state and witness costs.
